title: NF Trinity朱海伦：通胀与贸易摩擦边际缓和，利率路径迎来拐点？
speaker: Helen Zhu

segments.en: and kind of bring on some new leadership. Helen, talk to us as well about the sort of macro backdrop anywhere you look at things across assets.
segments.zh: 并带来一些新的领导层。Helen，也请和我们谈谈宏观背景，无论你从哪个角度看各类资产。

segments.en: And you see yields trending the way they are. Maybe partially to do with the easing inflation, potentially easing trade tensions as well.
segments.zh: 你看到收益率呈现这样的趋势。部分可能与通胀缓和有关，贸易紧张局势也可能缓和。

segments.en: How much of that is it going to be a driver for the rest of the year potentially given so many unknowns still as an overhang?
segments.zh: 鉴于仍有如此多的未知因素构成压力，这将在多大程度上成为今年剩余时间的驱动因素？

segments.en: I think it's probably going to be the primary driver to be honest and I think a lot of what's been happening already in the last few weeks in terms of negotiations in the Middle East,
segments.zh: 说实话，我认为这可能是主要驱动因素。过去几周在中东谈判方面已经发生了很多事，

segments.en: oil coming off a little bit. You know people are now thinking also previously that AI was a huge inflationary impulse, right?
segments.zh: 油价有所回落。你知道，人们现在也在想，之前认为AI是巨大的通胀推力，对吧？

segments.en: Because of driving all the component prices up, electronics and a smartphone and laptop prices up, etc.
segments.zh: 因为它推高了所有组件价格，电子产品和智能手机、笔记本电脑价格等。

segments.en: If that actually on the margin eases a little bit, then it comes back to the monetary policy.
segments.zh: 如果这在边际上有所缓和，那么问题就回到货币政策。

segments.en: So people are expecting that there will be a rate hike in the December meeting.
segments.zh: 所以人们预计12月会议将加息。

segments.en: But beyond that going into 2027, the market was pricing in to three rate hikes across the board for almost all the central banks.
segments.zh: 但除此之外，进入2027年，市场几乎对所有央行都定价了三次加息。

segments.en: So is that still going to happen if actually oil and inflation are less of a concern versus before?
segments.zh: 那么，如果实际上石油和通胀相比之前不那么令人担忧，这种情况还会发生吗？

segments.en: A lot of the policymakers said that they were data dependent.
segments.zh: 许多政策制定者表示，他们依赖数据。

segments.en: So if the data shifts then maybe the rates and yield curve will actually come down.
segments.zh: 因此，如果数据发生变化，那么利率和收益率曲线可能会下降。

segments.en: So I think that's going to be a pretty significant inflection point and a major deviation from the playbook that we had over the last three to six months.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这将是一个相当重要的拐点，并且与过去三到六个月的策略手册有重大偏离。
